fields.description: Uncheck to accept webhooks without sending email (they are logged as Received).
fields.label: Email notifications enabled

fields.description: Anti email-storm guard: within this window, repeat webhooks for the same event + site are logged as Suppressed instead of emailed. Protects provider quotas such as Gmail's ~500 mails/day cap. 0 disables.
fields.label: Dedupe window (minutes)

fields.description: Master X-Webhook-Secret accepted by every endpoint (used when a group has no own secret, and to protect unknown-slug 404s). Generated at install; rotate only if you know every sender's setup.
fields.label: Global fallback secret

fields.description: Optional sender override. Leave empty to use the default outgoing email account's sender.
fields.label: From email
